dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: ...Oh, you're not the enemy. Phew, you scared the life out of me!

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Just following orders from Sarge. If the enemy attacks, I have to report it straight away...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: But I'm short-sighted, and... I'm still waiting on my new spectacles after I broke the last pair...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: In the meantime... *sigh* Let's just hope it stays calm around here.

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: While the Millelith stands guard, e—evil shall, um, n—never prevail... Anyway, take care, sir... no wait, ma'am...?

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, I can't see your face clearly at this distance.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seen anyone around that looks a lot like me?

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Oh... So you were looking for someone to talk you... You gave me a fright.

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, someone did show up some time ago who had a very similar silhouette to yours...

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: ...But my glasses had already been broken before that. It's also possible that you passed this way earlier and I caught sight of you.

dialogues.speaker: Flagpole Cheng
dialogues.text: So, is the person I saw the one you're looking for? I don't know either...
